title.en: When and while: past continuous and past simple

ex.t: Quand je suis arrivé, il cuisinait.

ex.en: When I arrived, he was cooking.

ex.t: Pendant que je dormais, le téléphone a sonné.
ex.en: While I was sleeping, the phone rang.

ex.t: Quand nous sommes arrivés, il pleuvait.
ex.ko: 우리가 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요.
ex.en: When we arrived, it was raining.

ex.t: Je suis tombé pendant que je marchais.
ex.en: I fell while I was walking.

title.ko: quand / pendant que avec l'imparfait et le passé composé
title.en: when / while with the imperfect and the passé composé

explain.ko: 길게 이어진 배경 상황은 imparfait로, 그 사이에 일어난 짧은 사건은 passé composé로 말합니다. pendant que는 보통 긴 행동 앞에, quand은 짧은 사건 앞에 옵니다. soudain은 갑자기 일어난 일을 나타냅니다.
explain.en: Use the imperfect for the longer background action and the passé composé for the short event that interrupted it. Pendant que usually goes with the long action; quand often goes with the short event. Soudain introduces a sudden event.

head: 표현 / Structure
예 / Exemple
rows: Quand je suis arrivé, il cuisinait.
Pendant que je dormais, le téléphone a sonné.
Que faisais-tu quand le téléphone a sonné ?

notes.en: After pendant que the imperfect is usual.
After soudain use the passé composé.

practice.q: Pendant que je ___, le téléphone a sonné.

lines.t: Que faisais-tu quand le téléphone a sonné ?

trans.ko: (질문) 전화가 울렸을 때 뭐 하고 있었어요?
trans.en: (Question) What were you doing when the phone rang?

lines.t: J'ai vu un accident dans la rue hier.
J'attendais le bus. Soudain, une voiture a heurté une moto.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 길에서 사고를 봤어.
B: 정말? 그때 뭐 하고 있었어?
A: 버스를 기다리고 있었어. 갑자기 차가 오토바이와 부딪쳤어.
B: 다친 사람은 없었어?
trans.en:
A: I saw an accident in the street yesterday.
B: Really? What were you doing?
A: I was waiting for the bus. Suddenly a car hit a motorbike.
B: Was anybody hurt?

lines.t: Hier matin, je marchais dans le parc. Pendant que je marchais, j'ai vu un ami. Quand nous parlions, il a soudain commencé à pleuvoir. Nous sommes rentrés en courant.

trans.ko: 어제 아침에 나는 공원에서 걷고 있었어요. 걷는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 우리가 이야기하고 있을 때 갑자기 비가 오기 시작했어요. 우리는 집으로 달려갔어요.
trans.en: Yesterday morning I was walking in the park. While I was walking, I saw a friend. When we were talking, it suddenly started to rain. We ran home.

questions.q: Que s'est-il passé pendant qu'ils parlaient ?

lines.t: Vers trois heures de l'après-midi. Je marchais.
Une voiture bleue a grillé le feu rouge.

trans.ko:
직원: 사고는 언제 일어났어요?
손님: 오후 3시쯤이었어요. 저는 걷고 있었어요.
직원: 무엇을 봤어요?
손님: 파란 차가 신호를 무시했어요.
trans.en:
Clerk: When did the accident happen?
Guest: At about three in the afternoon. I was walking.
Clerk: What did you see?
Guest: A blue car went through the red light.

items.passage:
1) Quand je suis arrivé, il ___.
2) Pendant que je ___, le téléphone a sonné.
3) Je suis tombé pendant que je ___.

trans.ko: 1) 내가 도착했을 때 그는 요리하고 있었어요. 2) 내가 자는 동안 전화가 울렸어요. 3) 걷다가 넘어졌어요.
trans.en: 1) When I arrived, he was cooking. 2) While I was sleeping, the phone rang. 3) I fell while I was walking.

items.passage: Tom attendait le bus. Puis il a vu un vieil ami. Ils ont parlé pendant une heure.

trans.ko: 톰은 버스를 기다리고 있었어요. 그때 그는 오랜 친구를 봤어요. 그들은 한 시간 동안 이야기했어요.
trans.en: Tom was waiting for the bus. Then he saw an old friend. They talked for an hour.

prompt.ko: 과거진행형과 과거형으로 어제 일어난 일을 3문장으로 써 보세요 (when / while 사용).
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about something that happened yesterday using the past continuous and the past simple (with when / while).

task.model: Quand je suis arrivé à l'école, il pleuvait. Pendant que j'attendais le bus, j'ai vu un ami. Soudain, la pluie a cessé.

model_trans.ko: 내가 학교에 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요. 버스를 기다리는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 갑자기 비가 그쳤어요.
model_trans.en: When I arrived at school, it was raining. While I was waiting for the bus, I saw a friend. Suddenly the rain stopped.
